items.title: Proposition 3.35 and its extension-independence consequence

source.anchor: §3.4 Definition3.34/(3.27), equation(3.28), Proposition3.35 and following extension-choice verification; printed35–36/PDF51–52
source.attribution: Nicolas Boumal. Samplinglib attributed restatement. The canonical normed-space lemma generalizes only the selected curve proof edge.

items.statement: Let M⊆E and M′⊆E′ be embedded submanifolds of finite-dimensional Euclidean spaces, let F:M→M′ be smooth, and let F̄ be any smooth ambient neighborhood extension. For every x∈M, the manifold differential is DF(x)=D F̄(x)|_{TₓM}. Consequently it is linear, depends on a representing curve only through its base point and velocity, and is independent of the extension: any second extension F̂ gives D F̄(x)[v]=D F̂(x)[v] for v∈TₓM.

formulae.label: Selected extension-choice proof edge
formulae.tex: D\bar F(x)[v]=(\bar F\circ c)\prime(0)=(\widehat F\circ c)\prime(0)=D\widehat F(x)[v],\quad c(0)=x,\ c\prime(0)=v.

assumptions: M and M′ are embedded submanifolds of finite-dimensional Euclidean spaces; F:M→M′ is smooth.
F̄ and F̂ are smooth neighborhood extensions of the same F.
Each tangent v at x is represented by a smooth feasible curve c with c(0)=x and c′(0)=v.

obligations.label: Identify the actual manifold differential with the ambient derivative restricted to source tangent vectors, including the target tangent adapter.
Derive linearity and independence from the representing feasible curve.
Derive equality of two actual ambient derivatives on the velocity of a feasible curve from their local agreement.

bindings.boundary: This proves the actual nonlinear-curve extension-independence edge. It does not identify the full embedded-manifold differential, prove its tangent-space domain/codomain adapter or complete Proposition3.35/3.61.

assumption_deltas.source: Smooth neighborhood extensions between finite-dimensional Euclidean ambient spaces.
assumption_deltas.lean: Total maps between arbitrary real normed spaces, genuinely differentiable at one point.
assumption_deltas.reason: Only pointwise differentiability and local germs are used by the selected source chain-rule edge; no manifold differential identification follows.

assumption_deltas.source: Smooth feasible curve c with c(0)=x, c′(0)=v.
assumption_deltas.lean: Actual HasDerivAt c v t₀ and eventual feasibility in an arbitrary set.
assumption_deltas.reason: The argument is local at any parameter and requires only actual differentiability; source smooth feasible curves supply these conditions.

assumption_deltas.source: Both extensions agree with F on the manifold where defined.
assumption_deltas.lean: Relative local agreement f=g in 𝓝[s] (c t₀).
assumption_deltas.reason: Ambient open-neighborhood agreement is unnecessary. Source extensions agree on the feasible manifold near x.
